scope: Same-implementation fern RGB-only vs existing RGB+ED zero/uniform diagnostic
analysis_policy: Per-seed three-view arithmetic mean; paired differences, mean/sample SD/range/median; list every per-view regression. No p-value or formal equivalence conclusion with n=3. Historical old-source RGB seed42 kept separate.
evaluation_policy: Evaluate after all three new training runs; no test-driven setting changes
causal_limit: RGB-only omits prior cache and depth diagnostics as well as ED channels; CUDA trajectories not guaranteed identical. Descriptive path check, not isolated kernel causality.
